subject: Urban Planning
title: King Abdullah Economic City: Saudi Arabia's Unfinished Dream
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: King Abdullah Economic City: Saudi Arabia's Unfinished Dream.

hook.text: Saudi Arabia announced a $100 billion city for 2 million people in 2005. By 2024, fewer than 10,000 live there.

buildup.text: KAEC was meant to diversify the economy away from oil. It had an industrial port, golf courses, and luxury homes.

discovery.text: No major companies relocated. Workers commuted from Jeddah. The residential areas stayed mostly empty.

twist.text: Saudi Arabia then announced NEOM and The Line — even bigger projects. Some call it repeating the same mistake.

climax.text: Top-down cities rarely work. People cluster where jobs, culture, and networks already exist.

punchline.text: A city for two million. Population: 10,000. And counting... slowly.

quiz.question: What was KAEC's original goal?
options: Serving as Saudi Arabia's new capital replacing Riyadh
Diversifying the economy away from oil dependence
Creating a military base on the Red Sea coast
